text: Andhra Pradesh. Community tank or on-farm reservoir with plastic or RCC lining, for a group of 5 to 10 farmers, under MIDH: 75% assistance, cost norm Rs.24 lakh per unit (Rs.80 per cu.m) in general areas and Rs.30 lakh (Rs.100 per cu.m) in scheduled areas, for up to 30,000 cu.m irrigating 10 ha; smaller pro rata.

source.doc: Andhra Pradesh Horticulture Department, MIDH implementation guidelines 2025

subject: Andhra Pradesh MIDH new orchard area expansion subsidy
text: Andhra Pradesh. New orchards (area expansion) under MIDH: up to 40% of the total cost of plant material, inputs, supports and INM/IPM, paid over two years in a 60:40 ratio. The second year is paid only if at least 80% of plants survive. Paid by DBT. Land must be certified from the pattadar passbook or adangal. Per-hectare unit costs differ by crop and spacing.

source.doc: Andhra Pradesh Horticulture Department, MIDH implementation guidelines 2025

subject: Andhra Pradesh MIDH mushroom unit subsidy
text: Andhra Pradesh. Mushroom under MIDH: small mushroom production unit of 200 sq.ft, cost norm Rs.2 lakh, 50% assistance, up to 5 units per beneficiary, bank loan not needed. Larger production, spawn or compost units (Rs.20 to 30 lakh): 40% credit-linked back-ended subsidy for the private sector.

source.doc: Andhra Pradesh Horticulture Department, MIDH implementation guidelines 2025

subject: Andhra Pradesh MIDH farm gate pack house and cold room subsidy
text: Andhra Pradesh. Farm gate pack house (9m x 6m) under MIDH: unit cost limited to Rs.4.80 lakh, 50% assistance. Add-on farm gate cold room up to 10 MT: 35% of unit cost, unit cost limited to Rs.20 lakh (solar with battery), Rs.8 lakh (thermal storage on grid), Rs.12 lakh (biomass) or Rs.5 lakh (conventional grid). Land must be owned or on a registered lease of at least 10 years.

source.doc: Andhra Pradesh Horticulture Department, MIDH implementation guidelines 2025

subject: Andhra Pradesh paddy procurement rules KMS 2026-27
text: Andhra Pradesh. Paddy procurement, Kharif Marketing Season 2026-27 (Kharif and Rabi): MSP for FAQ paddy Rs.2,441 per quintal common, Rs.2,461 Grade A. Procured only from farmers (tenants included) registered in e-Panta through the Rythu Seva Kendram, at procurement centres in the RSKs; payment Aadhaar-based from e-Panta data. FAQ paddy moisture up to 17%; paddy not meeting FAQ is to be dried and cleaned, not refused outright. The farmer may choose the rice mill, but transport is paid at the lowest slab in the area and beyond 40 km is not paid. Millers buying privately must pay at least MSP into the farmer's bank account.

source.doc: G.O.Ms.No.15 CA,F&CS (CS.II) Dt.09.10.2026 - De-centralised procurement policy, KMS 2026-27

subject: Tamil Nadu CM Uzhavar Pathukappu Thittam farmer welfare benefits
text: Tamil Nadu. Chief Minister's Uzhavar Pathukappu Thittam: for agricultural labourers (including fisheries, dairy, horticulture, sericulture, cattle, poultry, plantation work) and small or marginal farmers owning up to 2.5 acres wet or 5 acres dry land who farm directly, cultivating tenants included, aged 18 to 65. Benefits for the member: marriage assistance Rs.8,000 (male) or Rs.10,000 (female); old age pension Rs.1,200 a month; Rs.1,000 a month while incapacitated by TB, cancer, HIV, dialysis, fractures and other listed illnesses; accident death Rs.1 lakh (landless labourers Rs.2 lakh), injury Rs.20,000 to Rs.1 lakh; natural death Rs.20,000 (landless Rs.30,000); funeral Rs.2,500 (landless Rs.10,000); paralysis Rs.50,000. Dependants: education help Rs.1,250 to Rs.6,750 a year, marriage assistance as above.

source.doc: Tamil Nadu Revenue and Disaster Management Department Policy Note 2026-27

subject: Tamil Nadu Agricultural Engineering Department earthmover hire charges
text: Tamil Nadu. Hire charges for Agricultural Engineering Department machinery, per hour. For farmers and government bodies: crawler excavator Rs.1,660, backhoe with front-end loader (JCB type) Rs.760, bulldozer Rs.970 (fixed by G.O.(Ms).No.149 of 21.10.2021). For private hirers and contractors: Rs.2,400, Rs.1,250 and Rs.1,550. Rates rise automatically when the PWD schedule of rates is revised; any later revision is not held.

source.doc: G.O.(Ms).No.61 Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (AE1) Dt.15.03.2022 - hire charges for AED machinery

subject: Tamil Nadu ration shop PDS entitlement and prices
text: Tamil Nadu. Ration (PDS), per family card per month. Rice free: PHH cards 5 kg per member, at least 12 kg for 1 adult, 14 kg for 1 adult and 1 child, 16 kg for 2 adults, 18 kg for 2 adults and 1 child, 20 kg for 3 adults, then 5 kg per member with no ceiling from the fourth member; AAY cards 35 kg; NPHH cards as PHH up to 3 units, with a ceiling of 20 kg. Wheat free in place of rice, up to 10 kg in Chennai and district headquarters and 5 kg elsewhere. Sugar 500 g per person, up to 2 kg, at Rs.13.50 a kg for AAY and Rs.25 for others; sugar-option cards get 3 kg more in place of rice. Tur dal 1 kg at Rs.30. Palmolein 1 litre at Rs.25. Kerosene 3 to 15 litres at Rs.15 to Rs.16.50 a litre, by area and LPG connections. A new family card costs Rs.50.
